study.title: Sweetpotato consumer testing of advanced clones, Ghana
study.description: Consumers tasted three sweetpotato samples and named the best and worst overall. Community and home tests. Genotype set: advanced_trial. Described in Moyo M, Ssali R, Namanda S, Nakitto M, Dery EK, Akansake D, Adjebeng-Danquah J, van Etten J, de Sousa K, Lindqvist-Kreuze H, Carey E, Muzhingi T (2021) Consumer preference testing of boiled sweetpotato using crowdsourced citizen science in Ghana and Uganda. Front. Sustain. Food Syst. 5:620363, https://doi.org/10.3389/fsufs.2021.620363. Data and code at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4117591. Tested in the last quarter of 2019

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised
location_privacy.gap_filling: Sites without a point take the mean of located sites with the same administrative names, pooled across all published trials (adm2+adm3, then adm3, then adm2, within 30 km of their mean), before rounding. coordinate_source names the level, coordinate_uncertainty_m adds the spread of the pool.

variables.description: Site identifier, trial id plus package number
Trial identifier. ClimMob v3 project id, or for legacy trials 11 hex characters plus 'v' (see decisions)
Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code
Country name
Crop tested in the trial
Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Where the original coordinate was taken (farm, interview point, adm3 mean of other sites, missing, removed)
Radius in metres around the published point that contains the original point (displacement plus spread of the sites used for gap filling)
Check of the original coordinate against the country boundary (ok, near_border, missing, outside, swapped_candidate, sign_flip_candidate)
First level administrative unit of the country (see metadata.admin_levels)
Second level administrative unit of the country
Name of the place below the lowest administrative level (village, community)
Gender of the participant
Age of the participant in years at registration
Where the consumer test took place (community test or home test)
Site identifier, links to site_data
Plot letter within the site (A, B, C)
Name of the genotype (variety) in the plot
Data collection moment (form) as named in the trial
Planned day of the collection moment, counted from the start of the trial as set in the trial design (the day of sowing in most designs); the same for every site. The actual date is moment_date
Day the form of the collection moment was filled in or submitted for the site (YYYY-MM-DD), the actual date of the observation; null when the source has none or the form was typed in after the season
Variable name, harmonised across trials
Identifier of the harmonised question
Question code or label as used in the trial
Value. For value_type rank, 1 is best and 3 is worst
rank, vs_local, numeric, date, categorical, multiple or text
Unit of numeric values. Yield values refer to the entire plot
Quality flag (implausible_yield_per_area, outlier_vs_trial_median, unit_unclear, derived)
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Overall preference of the cooked product
